regions.today: A cloudy evening with a few well scattered showers and moderate southwest winds.
regions.tonight: Starting off mostly cloudy with well-scattered showers. Clear spells will develop as the night progresses. A mild night with lowest temperatures ranging from 11 degrees in the north to 16 degrees in the south, with a light to moderate southwest breeze.
regions.tomorrow: A mainly dry and bright start with a few well scattered showers. Turning wet for the afternoon and evening with widespread rain developing. The rain will be heavy and persistent at times. Highest temperatures of 17 to 20 degrees, with moderate to fresh southwesterly winds.
